scopeLabel: Selected operational preparations, variant and control contexts, workup, storage and analytical preparations from all 9 main and 16 SI pages. Reported typical methods are distinct from incompletely specified plotted variants. InP clusters, conversion intermediates and InP/ZnSeS products are not conflated. Unknown zinc charges, shell feed allocation, batch identities and conflicting source labels remain explicit. This is source evidence, not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative review.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source images and reported size/shape evidence are retained. Finite particle geometry is not reconstructed. The independent InP bulk reference is gated to the two reported QD diffraction contexts; it is not a sample structure, cluster geometry or shell model.

bindings.caption: Drop-cast purified QD solution onto a glass substrate. No casting volume, drying time or temperature supplied. Drop-casting onto a glass substrate is shown schematically. Drop volume, substrate dimensions and drying conditions are not reported.

Acquire the reported Cu Kα diffraction pattern. Rigaku SMARTLAB 3 KW. Generic method range 20–80° differs from plotted extent 10–60° for S4 and 10–80° for main Fig 5; preserve stated ranges without inventing a corrected method. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
